Marta: Quick sync — roadmap call flagged alignment gaps on request/response for chat + tool-calls. Need to lock launch contract by EOD Fri.
Sam: What are must-have vs nice-to for GA? Customers pushing for trace_id + token_usage in envelope.
Alexa: Proposed minimal envelope: `{"response": ..., "metadata": {"model": "", "model_version": "", "trace_id": ""}, "token_usage": {"prompt_tokens": 0, "completion_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}` — token_usage can be optional depending on endpoint.
PJ: Question: should token field names be snake_case or camelCase? Partners care about consistency with SDKs.
Dong: token_usage is critical for billing/SLAs. For Dedicated & Private it must be present. Hosted public can be opt-out for privacy.
Sam: Suggest 2-tier contract: `core` (minimal metadata, no token_usage) and `enterprise` (full token_usage + audit fields). That keeps public payloads small.
Marta: Customers (Acme, DataCo) also expect deterministic structured output for function/tool calls. They want strict schemas for arguments.
Alexa: Tool-call result shape proposal: `{"tool_id": "namespaced/id", "tool_name": "", "status": "ok|error", "output": { ...schema... }, "invocation_trace": "rd-trace-id"}`
PJ: Naming: prefer snake_case for JSON fields (`tool_name`, `trace_id`) to match internal telemetry. Avoid mixedCase.
Dong: Agree on header name: use `rd-trace-id` as canonical trace header (36-char UUID). Add fallback `x-rd-trace-id` for older clients.
Sam: Rerank API needs a small, consistent item schema: `[{"id": "", "text": "", "score": 0.0, "provenance": ["sourceA"]}]` — include `score` (float) and `provenance` for audit.
Marta: Launch criteria (draft): docs + SDK examples, schema spec PR merged, automated backward-compat tests, telemetry for tokens & traces, rollout plan (canary -> 50% -> full), legal signoff on metadata retention.
Alexa: I'll open the spec PR with sample payloads, migration notes, and a compatibility table. ETA Thu midday.
PJ: +1 for review. I'll focus on naming conventions and the token_usage opt-in flow.
Acme_CSM: Heads-up: Acme needs 30d notice to opt into returning token_usage (security/compliance).
Marta: Noted — we'll include an opt-in migration/notification plan in the PR.
ops-bot: Reminder: infra deploy for schema flags scheduled 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC :rocket:
Sam: Scope negotiation: propose removing `attachments` from GA envelope; move to Phase 2. Keeps payloads smaller and unblocks docs.
Dong: Also add a small `meta.flags` map for opt-ins (e.g., `{"token_usage": "enabled"}`) so clients can declare expectations.
Alexa: Good idea — I'll include `meta.flags` and example SDK feature detect code snippet.
Marta: OK team — next steps: Alexa PR Thu, PJ review Thu afternoon, Marta will draft customer comms. If no major blockers, we aim to ship staged rollout week after next.
Sam: Thanks — will update roadmap ticket with tiers + launch checklist.
Acme_CSM: Thanks everyone, pls cc me on comms.
Marta: Will do — thanks all :thumbsup:
